newsitem.title: USA: IFS Intl Inc sees growth in net income.
newsitem.headline: IFS Intl Inc sees growth in net income.

text.p: IFS International Inc said thursday that it expects triple digit percentage growth in net income for the year ended April 30, over the previous year.

The company said that projected net income will be up by a significant amount when final year-end calculations are completed in mid-July, and it will also see substantial growth in revenues as a result of increased sales of its TPII software.
That software, said IFS, serves as a manager of EFT systems for ATM, Point-of-Sale and voice authorization.

The company also said it has its largest backlog in its history. As a result, it said, "we feel comfortable that we will continue to experience a comparable rate of growth in both revenues and net income."
IFS is engaged in the business of developing, marketing and supporting software products for the Electronic Funds Transfer market.
